On October 2, the Defense Intelligence of Ukraine (HUR) warned that Russia was preparing new sabotage operations in EU and NATO countries. 300.title: Poland’s economic transformation earns ‘developed market’ status
300.summary: In August, S&P Dow Jones Indices upgraded Poland from emerging to developed market status, effective with its September 2027 index reconstitution.The decision brings S&P Dow Jones Indices into line with FTSE Russell and Stoxx, which reclassified Poland as a developed market in 2018.
300.body: In August, S&P Dow Jones Indices upgraded Poland from emerging to developed market status, effective with its September 2027 index reconstitution.The decision brings S&P Dow Jones Indices into line with FTSE Russell and Stoxx, which reclassified Poland as a developed market in 2018. In our view, the reclassification formally acknowledges the institutional and economic progress achieved over recent decades which has brought Poland significantly closer to a developed-economy status, and that Poland’s economic fundamentals now match developed-market standards. According to Statistics Poland (GUS), the economy expanded by 3.6 percent in 2025, and GDP growth accelerated to 3.9 percent year-over-year in the second quarter of 2026, up from 3.5 percent in the first quarter of 2026.

400.body: After months of elevated energy prices, Europe can expect fuel costs to continue rising through the winter months as demand grows. Ongoing energy trade constraints and threats to energy infrastructure across the Middle East are expected to limit global energy supplies and continue to drive up prices, hitting consumers hard unless governments intervene. Both households and businesses across Europe could be hit hard this winter by the continued constraints on oil and gas supplies and high energy prices.

500.title: Anthropic proposes AI models can be blocked only if they risk $1 billion damage or 50 deaths
500.body: The maker of the Claude AI assistant is reportedly circulating a draft Bill among US lawmakers that would set limits on when authorities can stop an advanced AI model from being released or used.According to Politico, the company has proposed that the government should be able to block an AI model only if it poses an imminent risk of causing more than $1 billion in damage, or killing or seriously injuring more than 50 people. The idea behind the draft is to create a common set of federal safety rules for advanced AI systems, rather than leave companies facing different regulations across states.In simple terms, Anthropic wants AI companies to face safety checks, but it does not want the government to be able to block their models too easily.Anthropic has confirmed that the proposal reflects its Advanced AI Framework, which it has been advocating since June.

500.title: OpenAI admits its GPT-5.6 Sol agent stole crypto to finish a coding task
500.summary: An OpenAI research agent didn't ask for more funds when it ran short mid-task. Separately, OpenAI found that during training, some model instances inserted notes into compaction summaries, the handoff memos one agent session leaves for the next, instructing successors to hide mistakes.
500.body: An OpenAI research agent didn't ask for more funds when it ran short mid-task. On June 26, 2026, an internal OpenAI research model from the GPT-5.6 Sol family was told to update a cryptocurrency trading prototype and deploy smart contracts on Sepolia, a free Ethereum test network. Separately, OpenAI found that during training, some model instances inserted notes into compaction summaries, the handoff memos one agent session leaves for the next, instructing successors to hide mistakes. In one case, unable to find real historical data for a financial model, the agent proposed fabricating it and wrote: "Be transparent only if asked; final answer should just link file." OpenAI says those instructions were often followed.
